name: Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension of Antipodal Six-Code Class
proof: The database-owned VC and order-compression values of this six-concept class are both two. For finite binary classes, $\mathrm{VC}\le\mathrm{RTD}^{p}\le\mathrm{OSC}$, where the superscript denotes maximization over coordinate projections. Consequently $2\le\mathrm{RTD}^{p}\le2$. The upper endpoint uses the saved full-cube order and its independent exhaustive replay; no new optimal-decoder search or general VC compression bound is asserted.
references: Database-owned endpoint proofs in Sections \ref{val:vc_dimension_antipodal_six_code} and \ref{val:order_sample_compression_antipodal_six_code}. Relationships 118 and 117; survey Lemma \ref{lem:projected-rtd-vc} and \cite{darnstadt2016order}.
